comment:
* Keeps the flags related to the SystemUI namespace in {@link DeviceConfig}.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: NAS_GENERATE_REPLIES
variables.comment: * Whether the Notification Assistant should generate replies for notifications.

variables.name: NAS_GENERATE_ACTIONS
variables.comment: * Whether the Notification Assistant should generate contextual actions for notifications.

variables.name: NAS_MAX_MESSAGES_TO_EXTRACT
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of messages the Notification Assistant should extract from a
     * conversation when constructing responses for that conversation.

variables.name: NAS_MAX_SUGGESTIONS
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of suggestions the Notification Assistant should provide for a
     * messaging conversation.

variables.name: ENABLE_NAS_FEEDBACK
variables.comment: * Whether to enable feedback UI for Notification Assistant

variables.name: ENABLE_SCREENSHOT_NOTIFICATION_SMART_ACTIONS
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to enable smart actions in screenshot notifications.

variables.name: SCREENSHOT_NOTIFICATION_SMART_ACTIONS_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.comment: * (int) Timeout value in ms to get smart actions for screenshot notification.

variables.name: SCREENSHOT_NOTIFICATION_QUICK_SHARE_ACTIONS_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.comment: * (int) Timeout value in ms to get Quick Share actions for screenshot notification.

variables.name: SSIN_ENABLED
variables.comment: (boolean) Whether to enable smart suggestions in notifications.

variables.name: SSIN_REQUIRES_TARGETING_P
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether apps need to target at least P to provide their own smart replies (this
     * doesn't apply to actions!).

variables.name: SSIN_MAX_SQUEEZE_REMEASURE_ATTEMPTS
variables.comment:
* (int) The number of times we'll try to find a better line-break for double-line smart
     * suggestion buttons.

variables.name: SSIN_EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING
variables.comment: (boolean) Whether to let the user edit smart replies before sending.

variables.name: SSIN_SHOW_IN_HEADS_UP
variables.comment: (boolean) Whether smart suggestions should be enabled in heads-up notifications.

variables.name: SSIN_MIN_NUM_SYSTEM_GENERATED_REPLIES
variables.comment: (int) Minimum number of system generated replies to show in a notification.

variables.name: SSIN_MAX_NUM_ACTIONS
variables.comment: * (int) Maximum number of actions to show in a notification, -1 if there shouldn't be a limit

variables.name: SSIN_ONCLICK_INIT_DELAY
variables.comment:
* (int) The amount of time (ms) before smart suggestions are clickable, since the suggestions
     * were added.

variables.name: NAS_DEFAULT_SERVICE
variables.comment:
* The default component of
     * {@link android.service.notification.NotificationAssistantService}.

variables.name: HASH_SALT_MAX_DAYS
variables.comment: * (int) Maximum number of days to retain the salt for hashing direct share targets in logging

variables.name: PROPERTY_MIC_CAMERA_ENABLED
variables.comment: * Whether to show app ops chip for just microphone + camera.

variables.name: PROPERTY_LOCATION_INDICATORS_ENABLED
variables.comment: * Whether to show app ops chip for location.

variables.name: PROPERTY_MEDIA_PROJECTION_INDICATORS_ENABLED
variables.comment: * Whether to show privacy chip for media projection.

variables.name: PROPERTY_LOCATION_INDICATORS_SMALL_ENABLED
variables.comment: * Whether to show old location indicator on all location accesses.

variables.name: PROPERTY_LOCATION_INDICATORS_SHOW_SYSTEM
variables.comment: * Whether to show the location indicator for system apps.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_BEHAVIOR_MODE
variables.comment: * (String) Which behavior mode for the Assistant Handles to use.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOW_AND_GO_DURATION_MS
variables.comment: * (long) How long, in milliseconds, to display Assist Handles when showing them temporarily.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOW_AND_GO_DELAYED_SHORT_DELAY_MS
variables.comment:
* (long) How long, in milliseconds, to wait before showing the Assist Handles temporarily when
     * performing a short delayed show.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOW_AND_GO_DELAYED_LONG_DELAY_MS
variables.comment:
* (long) How long, in milliseconds, to wait before showing the Assist Handles temporarily when
     * performing a long delayed show.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOW_AND_GO_DELAY_RESET_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.comment: * (long) How long, in milliseconds, to wait before resetting delayed show delay times.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOWN_FREQUENCY_THRESHOLD_MS
variables.comment:
* (long) How long, in milliseconds, to wait before displaying Assist Handles temporarily after
     * hiding them.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_LEARN_TIME_MS
variables.comment:
* (long) How long, in milliseconds, for teaching behaviors to wait before considering the user
     * taught.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_LEARN_COUNT
variables.comment:
* (int) How many times for teaching behaviors to see the user perform an action to consider it
     * taught.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SUPPRESS_ON_LOCKSCREEN
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to suppress handles on lockscreen."

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SUPPRESS_ON_LAUNCHER
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to suppress handles on launcher."

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SUPPRESS_ON_APPS
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to suppress handles on apps."

variables.name: ASSIST_TAP_PASSTHROUGH
variables.comment: * Allow touch passthrough above assist area during a session.

variables.name: ASSIST_HANDLES_SHOW_WHEN_TAUGHT
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to show handles when taught.

variables.name: ASSIST_TRANSCRIPTION_DURATION_PER_PX_FAST
variables.comment: * (long) Duration per pixel, in milliseconds, of scrolling text at fast speed.

variables.name: ASSIST_TRANSCRIPTION_DURATION_PER_PX_REGULAR
variables.comment: * (long) Duration per pixel, in milliseconds, of scrolling text at regular speed.

variables.name: ASSIST_TRANSCRIPTION_FADE_IN_DURATION
variables.comment: * (long) Duration, in milliseconds, over which text fades in.

variables.name: ASSIST_TRANSCRIPTION_MAX_DURATION
variables.comment: * (long) Maximum total duration, in milliseconds, for a given transcription.

variables.name: ASSIST_TRANSCRIPTION_MIN_DURATION
variables.comment: * (long) Minimum total duration, in milliseconds, for a given transcription.

variables.name: NOTIFICATIONS_USE_PEOPLE_FILTERING
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether or not to enable an extra section in the notification shade which
     * filters for "people" related messages.

variables.name: NOTIFICATIONS_ALLOW_FGS_DISMISSAL
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether or not to enable user dismissing of foreground service notifications
     * into a new section at the bottom of the notification shade.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_MANAGER_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (bool) Whether to use the new BrightLineFalsingManager.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_SCREEN_FRACTION_MAX_DISTANCE
variables.comment: * (float) Maximum fraction of the screen required to qualify as a real swipe.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_VELOCITY_TO_DISTANCE
variables.comment: * (float) Multiplier for swipe velocity to convert it to pixels for a fling.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_HORIZONTAL_FLING_THRESHOLD_IN
variables.comment: * (float) How far, in inches, must a fling travel horizontally to qualify as intentional.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_VERTICAL_FLING_THRESHOLD_IN
variables.comment: * (float) Maximum fraction of the screen required to qualify as a real swipe.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_HORIZONTAL_SWIPE_THRESHOLD_IN
variables.comment: * (float) How far, in inches, must a continuous swipe travel horizontally to be intentional.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DISTANCE_VERTICAL_SWIPE_THRESHOLD_IN
variables.comment: * (float) How far, in inches, must a continuous swipe travel vertically to be intentional.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_PROXIMITY_PERCENT_COVERED_THRESHOLD
variables.comment:
* (float) Percentage of swipe with the proximity sensor covered that triggers a higher
     * swipe distance requirement.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DIAGONAL_HORIZONTAL_ANGLE_RANGE
variables.comment: * (float) Angle, in radians, that a swipe can vary from horizontal and sill be intentional.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_DIAGONAL_VERTICAL_ANGLE_RANGE
variables.comment: * (float) Angle, in radians, that a swipe can vary from vertical and sill be intentional.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_ZIGZAG_X_PRIMARY_DEVIANCE
variables.comment:
* (float) Distance, in inches, that a swipe is allowed to vary in the horizontal direction for
     * horizontal swipes.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_ZIGZAG_Y_PRIMARY_DEVIANCE
variables.comment:
* (float) Distance, in inches, that a swipe is allowed to vary in the vertical direction for
     * vertical swipes.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_ZIGZAG_X_SECONDARY_DEVIANCE
variables.comment:
* (float) Distance, in inches, that a swipe is allowed to vary in the horizontal direction for
     * horizontal swipes.

variables.name: BRIGHTLINE_FALSING_ZIGZAG_Y_SECONDARY_DEVIANCE
variables.comment:
* (float) Distance, in inches, that a swipe is allowed to vary in the vertical direction for
     * vertical swipes.

variables.name: SCREENSHOT_CORNER_FLOW
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether screenshot flow going to the corner (instead of shown in a notification)
     * is enabled.

variables.name: NAV_BAR_HANDLE_FORCE_OPAQUE
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to force the Nav Bar handle to remain opaque.

variables.name: NAV_BAR_HANDLE_SHOW_OVER_LOCKSCREEN
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to force the Nav Bar handle to remain visible over the lockscreen.

variables.name: SHARE_SHEET_DIRECT_SHARE_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: * (int) Timeout threshold, in millisecond, that Sharesheet waits for direct share targets.

variables.name: APPEND_DIRECT_SHARE_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether append direct share on Sharesheet is enabled.

variables.name: CHOOSER_TARGET_RANKING_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether ChooserTargets ranking on Sharesheet is enabled.

variables.name: DARK_LAUNCH_REMOTE_PREDICTION_SERVICE_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether dark launch of remote prediction service is enabled.

variables.name: PIP_STASHING
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to enable stashing for PIP.

variables.name: PIP_STASH_MINIMUM_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD
variables.comment:
* (float) The threshold velocity to cause PiP to be stashed when flinging from one edge to the
     * other.

variables.name: BACK_GESTURE_BOTTOM_HEIGHT
variables.comment: * (float) Bottom height in DP for Back Gesture.

variables.name: BACK_GESTURE_EDGE_WIDTH
variables.comment: * (float) Edge width in DP where touch down is allowed for Back Gesture.

variables.name: BACK_GESTURE_SLOP_MULTIPLIER
variables.comment: * (float) Slop multiplier for Back Gesture.

variables.name: SCREENSHOT_KEYCHORD_DELAY
variables.comment: * (long) Screenshot keychord delay (how long the buttons must be pressed), in ms

variables.name: USE_BACK_GESTURE_ML_MODEL
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to use an ML model for the Back Gesture.

variables.name: BACK_GESTURE_ML_MODEL_NAME
variables.comment: * (string) The name of the ML model for Back Gesture.

variables.name: BACK_GESTURE_ML_MODEL_THRESHOLD
variables.comment: * (float) Threshold for Back Gesture ML model prediction.

variables.name: SHARE_USE_SERVICE_TARGETS
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Sharesheet - Whether to use the deprecated
     * {@link android.service.chooser.ChooserTargetService} API for
     *  direct share targets. If true, both CTS and Shortcuts will be used to find Direct
     *  Share targets. If false, only Shortcuts will be used.

variables.name: APPLY_SHARING_APP_LIMITS_IN_SYSUI
variables.comment:
* (boolean) If true, SysUI provides guardrails for app usage of Direct Share by enforcing
     * limits on number of targets per app & adjusting scores for apps providing many targets. If
     * false, this step is skipped. This should be true unless the ranking provider configured by
     * [some other flag] is expected to manage these incentives.

variables.name: HOME_BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_DURATION_MS
variables.comment: * (long) The duration that the home button must be pressed before triggering Assist

variables.name: SHORTCUT_APPSEARCH_INTEGRATION
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether shortcut integration over app search service is enabled.

variables.name: IS_NEARBY_SHARE_FIRST_TARGET_IN_RANKED_APP
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether nearby share should be the first target in ranked apps.

variables.name: USE_UNBUNDLED_SHARESHEET
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether to enable the new unbundled sharesheet
     * (com.android.intentresolver.ChooserActivity).

variables.name: SHARESHEET_LIST_VIEW_UPDATE_DELAY
variables.comment:
* (int) The delay (in ms) before refreshing the Sharesheet UI after a change to the share
     * target data model. For more info see go/sharesheet-list-view-update-delay.

variables.name: DEFAULT_QR_CODE_SCANNER
variables.comment:
* (string) Name of the default QR code scanner activity. On the eligible devices this activity
     * is provided by GMS core.

variables.name: TASK_MANAGER_SHOW_FOOTER_DOT
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether the task manager should show an attention grabbing dot when tasks changed.

variables.name: TASK_MANAGER_SHOW_STOP_BUTTON_FOR_USER_ALLOWLISTED_APPS
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether the task manager should show a stop button if the app is allowlisted
     * by the user.

variables.name: TASK_MANAGER_SHOW_USER_VISIBLE_JOBS
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether the task manager should show apps running user-visible jobs.

variables.name: TASK_MANAGER_INFORM_JOB_SCHEDULER_OF_PENDING_APP_STOP
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether the task manager should tell JobScheduler it's about to ask for an
     * app stop.

variables.name: CLIPBOARD_OVERLAY_SHOW_ACTIONS
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to show smart chips (based on TextClassifier) in the clipboard overlay.

variables.name: CLIPBOARD_IGNORE_REMOTE_COPY_SOURCE
variables.comment:
* (boolean) Whether to ignore the source package for determining whether to use remote copy
     * behavior in the clipboard UI.

variables.name: COMBINED_BROADCAST_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to combine the broadcasts APPWIDGET_ENABLED and APPWIDGET_UPDATE

variables.name: CURSOR_HOVER_STATES_ENABLED
variables.comment: * (boolean) Whether to allow cursor hover states for certain elements.

variables.name: GENERATED_PREVIEW_API_RESET_INTERVAL_MS
variables.comment: * (long) The reset interval for generated preview API calls.

variables.name: GENERATED_PREVIEW_API_MAX_CALLS_PER_INTERVAL
variables.comment: * (int) The max number of generated preview API calls per reset interval.
